## DRM
### 0.3.3 Change Log
#### Global
##### Fixed
* Fixed excessive client logging during NPC model sync and NPC previews.
* Fixed successful quest reloads writing unnecessary log messages.
* Fixed repeated NPC provider failures flooding the console with duplicate stack traces.
* Fixed repeated NPC animation failures flooding the game log with warnings.
##### Changed
* Changed NPC shop profiling to default to off (`-Ddochi_rpg_maker.shopPerformanceDiagnostics=true` enables it).
* Changed routine NPC animation diagnostics and rejected requests to appear only in the game log when `-Ddochi_rpg_maker.animationDiagnostics=true` is enabled.
#### Forge 1.20.1 / Fabric & NeoForge 1.21.1
##### Fixed
* Fixed excessive GUI cache logging by removing frame summaries and limiting repeated errors.
#### Fabric & NeoForge 1.21.1 / 26.3
##### Fixed
* Fixed excessive client logging during currency HUD sync.
#### Fabric & NeoForge 1.21.1
##### Fixed
* Fixed blurred quest rows in the FTB Quests picker.
